clips.title: The story
paras: The Great Outdoors is an introductory wilderness survival quest offered by Brakk to aspiring adventurers. By learning to rest beside a basic campfire, travelers discover the fundamentals of sustaining themselves in the wild before pursuing practical tradeskills.

Venturing into the untamed reaches of Azeroth requires more than martial grit; it demands the basic knowledge to endure the elements. Brakk greets aspiring adventurers with a hearty 'Lok-tar', recognizing the restless spirit of those seeking fortune and glory. To survive the long road ahead, every traveler must first master the art of making camp and recovering their strength amidst the wilderness.

Taking a seat beside Brakk's Basic Campfire imparts the essentials of recuperation, granting a restorative rest in the open air. Once these survival fundamentals are understood, novice adventurers are directed toward local village craftsmen. There, they can learn tradeskills and discover how to build functional camp fixtures suited to their chosen craft.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lok-tar, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
